BiblicalUsage: To rob God is the charge Malachi lays on Israel: they have robbed Him in tithes and offerings, and the curse follows. Proverbs adds the other side, that the LORD will plead the cause of the poor and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe robbing God is not a bookkeeping problem, it is a heart problem, because the tithe was the test of whether Israel trusted Him to provide. What strikes me is that God calls it robbery, not forgetfulness, and that word should still sting.
